<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

prev = previous_frame.ascii.split('\n')
cur = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diffs=[]
for r in range(64):
    for c in range(64):
        if prev[r][c]!=cur[r][c]:
            diffs.append((r,c,prev[r][c],cur[r][c]))
print("diff count:", len(diffs))
# summarize by color transitions
from collections import Counter
print(Counter((d[2],d[3]) for d in diffs))
# bounding box of diffs
rs=[d[0] for d in diffs]; cs=[d[1] for d in diffs]
print("bbox:", min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
# show small crops around diff bbox
r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
for r in range(max(0,r0-1),min(64,r1+2)):
    print(r, cur[r][max(0,c0-1):c1+2])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
